title.zh: Circle and Tether Freeze Stablecoins Tied to Bitget Hack—But Most Funds Slip Away
title.en: Circle and Tether Freeze Stablecoins Tied to Bitget Hack—But Most Funds Slip Away

current_state.zh: Circle and Tether froze roughly $318,000 in USDC and USDT tied to the ~$387 million Bitget hack, while the attacker's ~170 ETH and other exploiter-held ETH remained beyond the issuers' reach.
current_state.en: Circle and Tether froze roughly $318,000 in USDC and USDT tied to the ~$387 million Bitget hack, while the attacker's ~170 ETH and other exploiter-held ETH remained beyond the issuers' reach.
